summary: Go Make Money: counts read right ("1 signup", not "1 signups") everywhere a count is printed. The views -> clicks step now says which clicks it compares ("247 of 257 clicks are on the 41 of 44 linked posts with views") in the funnel table, the step line, the report page and the outside judge prompt, so the two click numbers never look like a mismatch. The outside judge records the model it actually used and keeps only its final reply (codex exec -o), so no log lines reach the report. Landing page text decodes HTML entities (', & and the rest), and the short seller quote check still matches word for word.
